name: チーム指定付きの一括招待ダイアログ
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. LH09-0062 Japanese bulk workspace-invite dialog ONLY.
Original images1/2 PRIMARY for exact control anatomy, stroke/optical weights, proportions, input state, artwork and fine details; image3 SECONDARY Japanese copy/layout. Do not copy mock's minted initial/target-symbol substitutions or hide source addresses behind a count.
Compact logical560x326 WHITE rounded dialog with fine neutral border/subtle shadow on pure-white outer canvas, no app backdrop. Header ORIGINAL GREEN circular AM artwork, title「ワークスペースに招待」Meiryo Bold20/28; top-right original thin X close.
Label「メールアドレス」Regular14/24. White neutral-outline multiline input contains EXACT THREE original values, comma separated, readable/wrapping if needed:「jsmith.mobbin@gmail.com, jdoe.mobbin@gmail.com, samlee.mobbin@gmail.com」. These are technical email values, preserve verbatim; no fake placeholders/count-only substitute.
Next label「チームに追加（任意）」. White outlined team selector with ONE white fine-outline chip: original BLUE GLOBE artwork/icon (exact source silhouette, no target/club), Japanese team「ライトハウス」, thin separator and X removal control. Original small down-chevron at selector far right. Preserve all source controls/visible selected-team state; no mint chip.
Bottom-right forest-green gradient primary pill「招待を送信」with legible white label, gentle edge/small shadow; gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, no glossy streak. Supporting close/remove/chevron slate #526173; no random colored icons besides preserved AM/globe artwork. Other labels/body Meiryo Regular14/24, tracking0. Keep compact vertical grouping/source proportions, no extra helper copy, extra inputs or invented actions.
reviewNotes: All three source technical emails verbatim, Japanese title/labels/team/send, AM/globe appearances, close/remove/divider/chevron and green primary action visually checked. White surfaces/complete state retained. Exact artwork/font/proportions and actual invite sending unproved.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
